notes.title: V .15 Pre-Patch
notes.content:
[u][b]General Updates:[/b][/u]

[b]New enemy:[/b]
 
God of time

Passive:

Mind corruption: If an attack hits the player. They lose 4% wisdom.

Soul Corruption: If an attack hits the player. They lose 1% damage.


Summons fast lightning strikes at random locations dealing damage to the player if it hits. (Its recommended to have some sort of survivability by the time you get here.)

This boss spawns on wave 10



[u][b]Reworks:[/b][/u]
[b]Wisdom:[/b]
Now grants wisdom proc chance equal to half of wisdom.

[b]Entomb:[/b]
Movement Speed reduction 16%-->8%
Max Entomb 20 --> Infinite
(Bug) Entomb Damage 2x Force damage --> Force damage

[b]Buff:[/b]
Wraith Spawn chance 6% --> 10%

[b]Ability changes:[/b]
Entomb - No longer loses 1 armor or damage upon taking. Replaced with 2MPS and 1HP3S.
Now grants 5 entomb instead of 3


[u][b]BugFixes:[/b][/u]

-Fixed a bug that caused entomb to always deal 2x force damage.

notes.title: Patch V .15
notes.content:
[b]General Changes:[/b]
-Ability Spawn rates have been altered:

	Evoke Chance unchanged 4%
	Epic Upgrade Chance from 10% --> 17%
	Rare Upgrade Chance from 15% --> 21%
	Uncommon Upgrade Chance from 30 --> 26%
	Common Upgrade Chance from from 41% --> 30%

-Added Player Death Animation
-Increased the amount of times some bloodlines can be bought.
-Removed the redundant "Spend EP" button in the bat menu.

[b]BUFFS:[/b]
Evoke Pierce:
Now grants hidden +1 pierce

Enhanced Physique:
No longer costs 1 Max MP
Max HP from 3 --> 8
Armor from 2 --> 1

Clarity:
Now also grants +1 Max MP

[b]NERFS:[/b]
BloodWraith spawnrate from 18 --> 6
BloodWraiths can no longer spawn till round 4.


[b]New Upgrades:[/b]
Common:
Soul Feast: +2 Damage +2 Max MP

Uncommon:
Empower: +2 Force +1HP3S 

Rare:
Scarlet Weaver: +2HP3S +2MPS
Transendance: -1.5S Cooldown to transendance

Epic:
Physics Weaver: +1 Projectiles -1 MPS
Force Weaver: +3 Force +3 Damage
Wisdom Fusion: +1 Max Wisdom Procs (Can only be taken once)


BugFixes:

-Fixed a bug that caused players projectiles to randomly deactivate when fired. This was due to players damage being reduced below 1.
-Fixed a bug that made the Evoke "Pierce" not work.
-Fixed a bug that caused the pierce bloodline to not work.


ATTENTION!!
If you find any bugs please let me know. I tend to oversee some things. If you see anything that is missing or needs fixed feel free to make a post and ill fix it ASAP
